label: early copy-phase steps of length-9 sequences when re-reading t/z/g/q/e/0
explanation: Very sparse reset-gate unit, active only in the copy phase (100% of mass; never in the original or delimiter phases), almost entirely in L=9 sequences (92% of mass, L=8 most of the rest), and at early recall positions 1-3 (96% of mass; recall_idx 2 = step 11 alone is ~67%). The input token, which is the model's own previous output, is always one of t, z, g, q, e, 0 (t alone is ~50% of mass and the strongest activations, with the input t sitting at original position 1 or 2). It fires only on repeated tokens (in_first=0), which follows from the copy phase. The predicate covers 87% of mass but has very low precision (about 3%): most steps matching this context do not fire, and adding output-token or exact-position conditions only gets precision to about 9-14%, so the real trigger is a narrower conjunction that this description does not capture. Magnitude is largest for in_tok t at recall_idx 2 in L=9. A few weak activations at the last copy steps (recall_idx 7-8) are not explained.
